premise.zh: galgame 式的恋爱故事：读剧情、看人，在关键处做选择。好感藏在后台，只从对方的态度里感觉得到；共通线走完，按好感进入某个人的线。好玩在“当时随手的一句话，后来才知道有多重”。
premise.en: A visual-novel romance: read, watch the characters, choose at the key moments. Affection stays hidden and shows only in how they treat you; after the common route, affection decides whose route you enter. The fun is learning later how much a passing remark weighed.

risk.zh: 误会、流言：说错话、做错事积下来的。到线必须出事（一场误会、一次冷战），不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Misunderstanding, rumor: what careless words and deeds pile up. Crossing the line must cause something (a misunderstanding, a cold spell), not just change a number.

time.zh: 剩下的日子：离某个期限（毕业、拆迁、离开）还有多久。
time.en: Days left: how long until a deadline (graduation, demolition, a departure).

keepsake.zh: 信物、回忆：一起做过的事留下的东西，后面会在关键时刻用上。
keepsake.en: Keepsakes and memories: what shared moments leave behind, used later at a key moment.

failures.zh: 错过：该开口的时候没有开口
failures.en: Missed: you didn't speak when it mattered

failures.zh: 误会：一句话被听成了另一个意思
failures.en: Misunderstood: one remark heard as something else

failures.zh: 普通结局：谁都不够亲近，春天就这样过去了
failures.en: Normal ending: no one close enough, and the season simply passes

checklist.zh: 所有角色都是成年人；纯爱，不写露骨内容
checklist.en: Every character is an adult; romance stays non-explicit

checklist.zh: 好感不显示数字，只体现在台词、表情和后面的走向上
checklist.en: Affection is never shown as a number; only in lines, expressions and what follows

checklist.zh: 分歧点总有一条路可走：谁都不够时进普通结局，不卡死
checklist.en: Every branch point has a way forward: if no one is close enough, the normal ending, never a dead end

checklist.zh: 每条个人线都有好结局和普通结局，通关全部个人线后开启真结局
checklist.en: Every route has a good and a normal ending; clearing all routes opens the true ending
